target.title: fix(model-selection): warn on duplicate model aliases
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

When two config entries define the same alias, `findModelAliasCandidate` silently kept the **last** matching entry (dependent on `Object.entries` iteration order). There was no deterministic winner nor any indication that a conflict existed.

Example: if a config had both `{"openai/gpt-4": {alias: "best"}}` and `{"anthropic/claude": {alias: "best"}}`, which model gets selected when resolving "best" depended on the order of `Object.entries()`.

## Why This Change Was Made

Keep the **first** match and log a warning listing both conflicting `keyRaw` targets so operators can detect and fix duplicated aliases.

## User Impact

Operators with accidentally duplicated aliases will see a warning log instead of unpredictable last-wins behavior.

## Evidence

- `src/agents/model-selection-resolve.test.ts`: 5/5 ✅
- `src/agents/model-selection-display.test.ts`: 9/9 ✅
